metadata.author: Achyuta
metadata.system: Planet combinations in signs → life event predictions
metadata.timing_mechanism: Jupiter transit over the sign activates the combination
metadata.moon_reference: Moon sign (Janma Rashi) is primary reference point

principles: Moon is the Chandra Kala — everything is counted from Moon's position
When Jupiter transits a sign, all planets in that sign natally are activated
Planet pairs in the same sign produce specific predicted outcomes
The 2nd and 12th from Moon are gates of income and expenditure
7th from Moon governs partnerships and marriage activation

sun_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Recognition from authority, father-related events, career visibility
sun_alone.house_from_moon_1: Self-identity crisis or renewal around father/authority

moon_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Emotional clarity, mother-related events, public recognition

mars_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Property acquisition or disputes, sibling events, physical courage activated

mercury_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Business expansion, educational success, communication breakthroughs

jupiter_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Self-transit — powerful activation of wisdom, children events, spiritual growth
jupiter_alone.note: Jupiter transiting its own natal position is a major 12-year milestone

venus_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Marriage events, relationship breakthroughs, artistic success, material gains

saturn_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Karmic reckoning, discipline pays off or breaks down, service-related events

rahu_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Foreign connections activated, unconventional gains, ambition peaks

ketu_alone.when_jupiter_transits: Spiritual experiences, past karma completing, occult knowledge awakens

sun_moon.condition: Sun and Moon in same sign (Amavasya-like natal)
sun_moon.life_prediction: New Moon soul — intense, singular focus. Mother and father themes merge. Public and private self unified. When triggered: major identity events, parents-related milestones, public recognition tied to personal transformation.
sun_moon.timing: Jupiter transiting this sign = major personal milestone year
sun_moon.health: Heart and mind need balancing — pitta constitution

sun_mars.condition: Sun and Mars in same sign
sun_mars.life_prediction: Fiery warrior combination. Father-son or authority-action themes. Physical courage peaks. When triggered: conflicts with authority OR victories through bold action, property/sibling events involving father.
sun_mars.timing: Jupiter transit = peak career assertion year, possible confrontations

sun_mercury.condition: Sun and Mercury in same sign (Budhaditya Yoga)
sun_mercury.life_prediction: Intelligence illuminated by authority. Communication gifts. Business through government or authority. When triggered: intellectual recognition, writing/speaking achievements, business-government connections.
sun_mercury.yoga: Budhaditya Yoga — intelligence, business acumen, communication skills
sun_mercury.timing: Jupiter transit = peak intellectual recognition, writing/speaking success
sun_mercury.health: Nervous system under solar heat — eye strain, mental fatigue

sun_jupiter.condition: Sun and Jupiter in same sign
sun_jupiter.life_prediction: Dharmic leader. Father as teacher or spiritual guide. Authority through wisdom. When triggered: elevation in dharmic/spiritual matters, father-related blessings, status through knowledge.
sun_jupiter.timing: Jupiter transit = 12-year dharmic milestone, possible guru connection

sun_venus.condition: Sun and Venus in same sign
sun_venus.life_prediction: Charismatic combination. Beauty and authority. Arts and government intersect. When triggered: romantic events involving status, creative recognition, luxury gains.
sun_venus.timing: Jupiter transit = peak charisma year, possible marriage or public artistic success
sun_venus.health: Venus combust Sun weakens this — relationship difficulties if Venus very close to Sun

sun_saturn.condition: Sun and Saturn in same sign
sun_saturn.life_prediction: Most challenging combination. Father-karma heavy. Authority vs. discipline clash. When triggered: major karmic events around father, authority, government — either debt paid OR new debt incurred.
sun_saturn.timing: Jupiter transit = karmic reckoning with authority/father themes
sun_saturn.bphs_note: Visha Yoga when in certain houses — requires careful analysis
sun_saturn.health: Bones, heart, chronic conditions from stress

sun_rahu.condition: Sun and Rahu in same sign (Grahan Yoga)
sun_rahu.life_prediction: Grahan (eclipse) energy. Father or authority figures have Rahu-like qualities (foreign, unconventional, obsessive). Identity eclipse — the self seeks something beyond ordinary. When triggered: sudden foreign connections, unconventional career moves, identity upheavals.
sun_rahu.dosha: Surya Grahan Dosha — can affect father's health and native's authority
sun_rahu.timing: Jupiter transit = eclipse activation, unexpected foreign-authority events

sun_ketu.condition: Sun and Ketu in same sign
sun_ketu.life_prediction: Past-life authority themes. Natural detachment from ego. Spiritual leadership without ego. When triggered: past karma with father/authority completing, spiritual recognition.
sun_ketu.timing: Jupiter transit = spiritual milestone, ego-death and renewal

moon_mars.condition: Moon and Mars in same sign
moon_mars.life_prediction: Emotional intensity and volatility. Mother and sibling themes intertwined. Chandra-Mangal Yoga for material gains (if well-placed). When triggered: emotional confrontations, mother-sibling events, property matters involving mother.
moon_mars.yoga: Chandra-Mangal Yoga — business acumen, material gains through emotional intelligence
moon_mars.timing: Jupiter transit = emotional peak year, possible property purchase, mother events
moon_mars.health: Blood and bile disorders, emotional inflammation
challenging: Anger from mother or toward mother

moon_mercury.condition: Moon and Mercury in same sign
moon_mercury.life_prediction: Emotional intelligence, creative writing, healing abilities. Mind and heart aligned. When triggered: educational success through emotional intelligence, writing/healing career peaks.
moon_mercury.timing: Jupiter transit = emotional-intellectual peak, healing/writing recognition

moon_jupiter.condition: Moon and Jupiter in same sign (Gaja Kesari potential)
moon_jupiter.life_prediction: Wisdom flows through emotion. Nurturing teacher. Mother as spiritual guide. When triggered: emotional wisdom recognized, spiritual teachings given or received, mother's blessings.
moon_jupiter.yoga: Potential Gaja Kesari Yoga if in angular houses — prosperity and recognition
moon_jupiter.timing: Jupiter transit = major emotional-spiritual milestone, recognition

moon_venus.condition: Moon and Venus in same sign
moon_venus.life_prediction: Deep beauty sense, artistic gifts, love of comfort. Mother and wife themes connected. When triggered: marriage events, artistic recognition, material comfort peaks, mother-related relationship events.

moon_saturn.condition: Moon and Saturn in same sign (Visha Yoga potential)
moon_saturn.life_prediction: Emotional restriction and karmic duty. Mother with Saturn qualities (disciplined, cold, or ill). Emotional maturity through suffering. When triggered: major karmic emotional clearing, mother health events, depression or breakthrough.
moon_saturn.yoga: Possible Visha Yoga — emotional poison that becomes medicine through tapas
moon_saturn.timing: Jupiter transit = karmic emotional reckoning, possibly mother health event

moon_rahu.condition: Moon and Rahu in same sign
moon_rahu.life_prediction: Unusual mother or unusual emotional nature. Foreign emotional connections. Obsessive mind. When triggered: foreign travel with emotional significance, unusual relationships, obsessive episodes.
moon_rahu.timing: Jupiter transit = peak foreign-emotional activation, unusual relationship events

moon_ketu.condition: Moon and Ketu in same sign
moon_ketu.life_prediction: Psychic and past-life emotional memories. Detached mother. Spiritual sensitivity. When triggered: past-life memories surface, spiritual experiences through emotions, mother's spiritual journey.
moon_ketu.timing: Jupiter transit = spiritual-emotional peak, past karma with mother completing

mars_mercury.condition: Mars and Mercury in same sign
mars_mercury.life_prediction: Engineering mind, debate champion, sharp communication. Business through courage. When triggered: technical achievements, business victories through communication, sibling-education events.
mars_mercury.timing: Jupiter transit = peak technical/debate achievement year

mars_jupiter.condition: Mars and Jupiter in same sign
mars_jupiter.life_prediction: Dharma warrior. Legal victories. Land and property through wisdom. When triggered: legal wins, property purchases, dharmic assertion, possible guru or military connection.
mars_jupiter.timing: Jupiter transit = major land/property year, legal victory or challenge

mars_venus.condition: Mars and Venus in same sign
mars_venus.life_prediction: Passionate relationships. Arts and physical activity linked. Desire activated. When triggered: intense romantic events, creative physical work, passion peaks.

mars_saturn.condition: Mars and Saturn in same sign
mars_saturn.life_prediction: Discipline through pain. Slow but powerful action. Karmic warrior. When triggered: major karmic confrontations involving property/siblings, disciplined effort peaks, possible surgery or accident.
mars_saturn.timing: Jupiter transit = karmic action reckoning, test of discipline

mars_rahu.condition: Mars and Rahu in same sign (Angarak Yoga)
mars_rahu.life_prediction: Explosive, unpredictable energy. Foreign aggression or unconventional warfare. When triggered: sudden aggressive events, foreign conflicts, technical/military events.
mars_rahu.yoga: Angarak Yoga — explosive combination, needs careful management
mars_rahu.timing: Jupiter transit = most volatile year, explosive events possible

mars_ketu.condition: Mars and Ketu in same sign
mars_ketu.life_prediction: Past-life warrior energy. Martial spirituality. Sudden courage or sudden retreat. When triggered: past karma with siblings/property completing, spiritual martial events.
mars_ketu.timing: Jupiter transit = past-life warrior karma activation

mercury_jupiter.condition: Mercury and Jupiter in same sign
mercury_jupiter.life_prediction: Scholar-businessman. Teaching and trade united. When triggered: educational peaks, teaching recognition, business-wisdom integration.
mercury_jupiter.timing: Jupiter transit = peak scholarly or business-wisdom year

mercury_venus.condition: Mercury and Venus in same sign
mercury_venus.life_prediction: Creative communicator. Arts and commerce linked. Beauty in words. When triggered: artistic-business success, creative communication peaks.

mercury_saturn.condition: Mercury and Saturn in same sign
mercury_saturn.life_prediction: Systematic thinker, meticulous analyst. Slow but deep communication. When triggered: technical mastery recognized, systematic business events.
mercury_saturn.timing: Jupiter transit = recognition for systematic work, technical mastery

mercury_rahu.condition: Mercury and Rahu in same sign
mercury_rahu.life_prediction: Unconventional intellect, technology innovator. Foreign communication links. When triggered: technology breakthroughs, foreign education, unconventional business.
mercury_rahu.timing: Jupiter transit = technology/foreign communication peak year

mercury_ketu.condition: Mercury and Ketu in same sign
mercury_ketu.life_prediction: Intuitive intellect, past-life knowledge. Communication dissolves into silence. When triggered: deep past-life knowledge surfaces, mystical communication, intellectual detachment.

jupiter_venus.condition: Jupiter and Venus in same sign
jupiter_venus.life_prediction: Abundance and beauty. Dharma and desire aligned. Marriage through dharmic connections. When triggered: peak abundance year, marriage through dharmic channels, artistic-spiritual success.
jupiter_venus.timing: Jupiter transit = most auspicious year for marriage and material abundance

jupiter_saturn.condition: Jupiter and Saturn in same sign
jupiter_saturn.life_prediction: The Great Conjunction energy. Wisdom through discipline. Dharma through karma. 20-year cycles. When triggered: major life restructuring, wisdom through hardship, karmic rewards.

jupiter_rahu.condition: Jupiter and Rahu in same sign (Guru-Chandal Yoga)
jupiter_rahu.life_prediction: Wisdom from unconventional sources. Foreign guru. Dharma through taboo-breaking. When triggered: unconventional wisdom peaks, foreign spiritual connections, dharma challenged.
jupiter_rahu.yoga: Guru-Chandal Yoga — wisdom tested through taboo or foreign influences
jupiter_rahu.timing: Jupiter transit = peak unconventional wisdom activation

jupiter_ketu.condition: Jupiter and Ketu in same sign
jupiter_ketu.life_prediction: Moksha-seeking wisdom. Past-life spiritual knowledge. Teacher who renounces. When triggered: spiritual moksha experiences, past-life wisdom integrates, possible spiritual renunciation.

venus_saturn.condition: Venus and Saturn in same sign
venus_saturn.life_prediction: Love through duty. Restricted or delayed relationships. Discipline in arts. When triggered: marriage after delay, karmic relationship events, artistic discipline recognized.
venus_saturn.timing: Jupiter transit = karmic relationship resolution year

venus_rahu.condition: Venus and Rahu in same sign
venus_rahu.life_prediction: Unconventional beauty, foreign relationships, obsessive love. When triggered: foreign romantic events, unusual artistic breakthroughs, obsessive relationship patterns.

venus_ketu.condition: Venus and Ketu in same sign
venus_ketu.life_prediction: Spiritual beauty, detachment from relationships, past-life love karma completing. When triggered: past relationship karma completing, spiritual art, beauty of detachment.
venus_ketu.timing: Jupiter transit = past romantic karma resolution

saturn_rahu.condition: Saturn and Rahu in same sign (Shrapit Yoga potential)
saturn_rahu.life_prediction: Cursed karma — extreme karmic debt from past lives. Foreign-karmic difficulties. When triggered: major karmic events, foreign-related hardships, karmic debt peaks.

saturn_ketu.condition: Saturn and Ketu in same sign
saturn_ketu.life_prediction: Double detachment and karma. Ascetic energy. Past-life karmic completion through discipline. When triggered: ascetic experiences, past karma completing through hardship.
saturn_ketu.timing: Jupiter transit = peak karmic completion through austerity

rahu_ketu.condition: Rahu and Ketu — always in opposite signs (axis)
rahu_ketu.note: Never conjunct — they form the karmic axis between two signs

sun_moon_rahu.life_prediction: Solar eclipse energy natally. Intense identity with karmic foreign overlays. Powerful but unstable.
sun_moon_rahu.timing: Jupiter transit = identity eclipse events, possible foreign upheaval

moon_mars_saturn.life_prediction: Triple emotional pressure. Mother, aggression, and karma together. Powerful transformative suffering.
moon_mars_saturn.timing: Jupiter transit = most intense emotional-karmic year

jupiter_venus_mercury.life_prediction: Triple abundance — wisdom, beauty, intellect. Peak prosperity combination.
jupiter_venus_mercury.timing: Jupiter transit = most abundant year of the 12-year cycle

jupiter_timing_rules.description: Jupiter takes 12 years to complete one cycle. Each transit through a sign activates natal planets there.
jupiter_timing_rules.activation_window: Jupiter within 5° of natal planet = approaching activation; exact conjunction = peak; within 5° past = settling
jupiter_timing_rules.current_positions_note: Check current Jupiter sign vs natal planet signs for active activations
jupiter_timing_rules.retrograde_effect: Jupiter retrograde in a sign = second activation of those natal planets — review and internalize

12_year_cycle.year_1: Jupiter transits natal planet sign — direct results manifested
12_year_cycle.year_6: Jupiter in 7th from natal sign — relationship mirror of those themes
12_year_cycle.year_12: Jupiter returns — completion and renewal of those themes

ckn_reading_methodology.step_1: Identify all planets and their natal signs
ckn_reading_methodology.step_2: Group planets by sign — find all conjunctions
ckn_reading_methodology.step_3: For each conjunction, look up the planet_pairs_same_sign rules
ckn_reading_methodology.step_4: Identify current Jupiter sign — which natal planets is it activating?
ckn_reading_methodology.step_5: Check Jupiter's distance from each natal planet for activation status
ckn_reading_methodology.step_6: Read the 'when_jupiter_transits' result for currently activated combinations
ckn_reading_methodology.step_7: Note upcoming Jupiter transits for future event predictions
